ctaHeading: Thornbury's Auto Electricians Are Ready to Help
aboutText: Established in 1975, MG Auto Electrics has been serving Thornbury and surrounding areas for over 45 years. We specialise in Australian, Asian, and European vehicles, offering complete mechanical and auto electrical repairs with advanced diagnostic technology. Our qualified technicians use only quality parts, ensuring your vehicle performs at its best while keeping you informed every step of the way.
servicesText: At MG Auto Electrics, we provide a full range of services from auto electrical repairs to scheduled logbook servicing. Using the latest diagnostics, we ensure accurate fault detection and high-quality repairs for all vehicle types.

services.title: Auto Electrical Services
services.desc: Expert repairs for all auto electrical systems, including wiring, batteries, and alternators, ensuring your vehicle's electrical components function perfectly.

services.title: Scheduled Logbook Service
services.desc: Manufacturer-approved logbook servicing to maintain your warranty, using quality parts and advanced diagnostics for optimal performance.

services.title: Advanced Fault Detection
services.desc: Utilising the latest diagnostic technology to accurately identify and resolve complex vehicle issues efficiently.

services.title: Air Conditioning Servicing
services.desc: Comprehensive A/C system checks, regas, and repairs to keep your car's climate control in top condition.

services.title: Brake and Clutch
services.desc: Professional inspection, repair, and replacement of brake and clutch systems for safe and smooth driving.

services.title: Complete Mechanical Repairs
services.desc: From engine tuning to transmission repairs, we handle all mechanical aspects with expertise and precision.
